heroHeadline: DPRK Hosts Vietnam FM in Pyongyang as Trump-Kim Summit Signals Emerge Without Groundwork
heroSubtitle: North Korean Foreign Minister Choe Son-hui hosted Vietnamese counterpart Le Hoai Trung in Pyongyang on May 14, 2026, deepening ties with one of Pyongyang's few remaining non-Russia, non-China diplomatic partners. A senior Seoul official simultaneously said Trump-Kim summit preparations are 'almost nonexistent' despite Trump's May 12 remark that he could meet Kim this month. UN Human Rights Chief Türk separately called for ICC accountability for DPRK crimes against humanity on May 13 during his first visit to South Korea in 11 years, and affirmed non-refoulement protection for DPRK POWs held by Ukraine.
footerNote: Data sourced from US/ROK official reports, KCNA, UN panels, IAEA, and institutional analyses. North Korea does not publish national statistics — economic figures are estimates with wide uncertainty ranges.
